properties.name: Türkiye, East Anatolian Fault corridor
properties.description: Corridor defined by rupture, not an official region: an octagon along the left-lateral East Anatolian Fault from the Amanos/Hatay segment near 36 E, 36 N to the Karliova junction near 41 E, 39.3 N, about 150 km wide. Includes the 2023 Kahramanmaras doublet.
references: Duman & Emre 2013, Geol. Soc. London Spec. Publ. 372 (EAF segmentation)
